text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Shield goes to Mejiro McQueen!
Here and now, she proves why the family name is renowned!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I fell completely short!
To think the gap was this big... jeez...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of McQueen-san!
Brushing off even that immense pressure,
she brilliantly fulfilled the long-cherished Mejiro ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Still, with Lady Ryan like this... is Lady McQueen truly the one who will lead the Mejiro family from now on...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I may have lost today, but I will seize glory next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro family! I'll make sure to show everyone that Mejiro Ryan is here too, right at the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right!!
That's right, isn't it, Ryan-sama!
I will continue to support you!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I was just being frustrated all this time...
and wasn't paying attention to everyone else.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Ryan-chan was listening to the fans' voices.
And she immediately followed up...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That is what an Umamusume who carries expectations looks like.
The difference between me and Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've decided. In the Takarazuka Kinen, I'll...!
